description: Twenty lines, for a tall boy

participation.context: Struck the twenty and wrote the two lines.
participation.name: William Shakespeare

relations.note: the exchange is for his height, and he is not in the room

story.body: From the bolsters you cut the stale exchange and wrote a shorter one for a tall boy. You did not write the songs, and you did not write the last line.

relations.note: the exchange is for his height, and he is not in the room

title: Struck twenty lines and wrote two

participation.context: Said the fever was gone and the letter was not answered.
participation.name: William Shakespeare

relations.note: he stays in the bed she named

story.body: You stayed in bed after the fever left. You did not answer the letter. You left the songs and the last line for another day.

relations.note: he stays in the bed she named

title: Noted that the fever had gone
